description: Source file containing utility functions for the game Unvanquished, including color parsing, chat color selection, size and time formatting, key catcher setup, and model rotation application.

methods.name: CG_ParseColor
methods.description: Parses color values from text input into a byte array.

methods.name: UI_GetChatColour
methods.description: Returns a color object based on chat message type and team.

methods.name: CG_ReadableSize
methods.description: Formats a size value into a human-readable string.

methods.name: CG_PrintTime
methods.description: Converts time in milliseconds to a human-readable string.

methods.name: CG_SetKeyCatcher
methods.description: Sets the key catcher context for input handling.

methods.name: CG_ApplyModelRotationToAxis
methods.description: Applies a model rotation to an axis matrix.
